goal: Strictly greater than 75% pure wins against all 15 frozen opponents, learned improvements only, expandable market vocabulary
metric: wins / all games strictly > .75; draws are not wins
seeds: Every match has its own unique seed, disjoint from all known prior registered seeds
initialization: Warm start from trained expanded candidate; this is not a promotion of that candidate
architecture: Retain the independent market quantity MLP and all existing command classes

training.rare_sampling: Uniform training examples across every class introduced since the original 1349-class reference, including retained and newly added classes
training.selection: Lowest validation loss among trained checkpoints; reject before games if full action accuracy drops more than 0.5 percentage points
training.method: Teacher BC with accumulated rare-class rehearsal, fresh balanced rollouts, automatic vocabulary union and independently trainable market quantities
training.trainable: Market pattern head, pattern embedding and market quantity MLP; shared encoder, unit head and unit quantity MLP frozen

constraints.vocabulary_source: Union of initialization and training labels only; expandable each round

cpu.scope: Only owned job and descendants are throttled; unrelated activity can exceed whole-machine ceiling
